description: This file defines a template class 'absl::uniform_int_distribution' for generating uniformly distributed random integers over a specified inclusive range. It includes methods for setting parameters, generating random values, and serialization support. The class is part of the Abseil C++ library's random utilities.

classes.name: absl::uniform_int_distribution
classes.description: A template class for generating uniformly distributed integers within a specified range.

classes.name: absl::uniform_int_distribution::param_type
classes.description: A nested class representing the parameters (lower and upper bounds) of the distribution.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Generates a random integer using the provided generator and current parameters.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the distribution (no effect in this implementation).

methods.name: a
methods.description: Returns the lower bound of the distribution.

methods.name: b
methods.description: Returns the upper bound of the distribution.

methods.name: param
methods.description: Gets or sets the distribution parameters.

methods.name: min
methods.description: Returns the minimum value of the distribution.

methods.name: max
methods.description: Returns the maximum value of the distribution.
